name: Vault Token Manager
description: Secure interface for managing encrypted tokens in the ScareVerse Browser Extension Vault

_discovery.describe: Administrative utility for managing HashiCorp Vault tokens and secrets. Provides secure interface for token generation, renewal, revocation, and TTL management. Supports role-based token creation and policy assignment. Includes secret browser with KV store visualization. All operations are audited and encrypted. Processing time ~500ms-2s for token operations. Requires Vault server connection and admin permissions. Essential for secure credential management in production environments.
